name: personal-ops
title: Personal Ops
description: Daily brief for Calendar, Gmail, Linear, and personal action items.
author: diptayan_jash

commands.name: brief
commands.title: Good Morning
commands.subtitle: Day at a glance
commands.description: Show today's Calendar, Gmail, Linear, and attention list.

preferences.name: envPath
preferences.title: Env File Path
preferences.description: Optional local .env file path. Leave empty if you configure credentials directly in preferences.

preferences.name: timezone
preferences.title: Timezone
preferences.description: Timezone used to calculate today's brief window.

preferences.name: linearApiKey
preferences.title: Linear API Key
preferences.description: Optional override. If empty, the extension reads LINEAR_API_KEY from the env file.

preferences.name: linearDefaultTeam
preferences.title: Linear Default Team
preferences.description: Optional override for the default team used when creating Linear issues.

preferences.name: googleClientId
preferences.title: Google Client ID
preferences.description: Optional override. If empty, the extension reads GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID from the env file.

preferences.name: googleClientSecret
preferences.title: Google Client Secret
preferences.description: Optional override. If empty, the extension reads GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET from the env file.

preferences.name: googleRefreshToken
preferences.title: Google Refresh Token
preferences.description: Optional override. If empty, the extension reads GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN from the env file.

preferences.name: geminiApiKey
preferences.title: Gemini API Key
preferences.description: Optional override. If empty, the extension reads GEMINI_API_KEY from the env file.

preferences.name: geminiModel
preferences.title: Gemini Model
preferences.description: Model used only to write the four short brief lines.

preferences.name: briefTone
preferences.title: Brief Tone
preferences.description: Writing style for the Gemini summary lines.

preferences.name: summaryMode
preferences.title: Summary Mode
preferences.description: Choose whether to show a fast deterministic summary while Gemini refreshes, or rely only on Gemini.

preferences.name: useGeminiCache
preferences.title: Use Gemini Cache
preferences.label: Use cached Gemini summaries
preferences.description: Show cached Gemini summaries while a fresh one loads.
